name: Amplitude
description: Amplitude is a digital analytics platform that helps businesses understand user behavior, measure product performance, and improve customer experiences through product analytics and experimentation.

events.d: Send a custom event for a user or device to your Amplitude project.
Get a user summary and their most recent or earliest events from Amplitude.
Find Amplitude users by Amplitude ID, Device ID, User ID or User ID prefix.
Add an annotation (release, campaign, incident) to all charts or one chart in Amplitude.
Add users to or remove users from an existing Amplitude cohort.
